Looking ahead one month, barring an unannounced policy reversal or financial emergency requiring Fed intervention, the balance sheet will continue its downward drift at the same mechanical pace. The next month-end reading should show further decline of approximately $40-45B, placing total assets near $7,035-7,040B. The evidence for continued QT is decisive: assets are falling steadily, policy language remains unchanged, and no offsetting purchases are underway.

This is not a prediction of economic stress or market dislocations—only an observation that announced runoff policy is proceeding as specified.
